Sub:
Implementation
of ISO 9001 Certification for field offices of EPFO- Reg.
Ref:
1.
Headquarters letter dated 09.11.2012
at serial no. 411 on the EPFO website.
2.
Headquarters reminder dated 28.12.2012
at serial no. 500 on the EPFO website.
Sir,
Please refer to this office letters cited above.
2.
As achieving
ISO 9001:2008
certification
is a mandatory
success indicator
of the RFD 2012-13
&
2013-14,
it is therefore
once again requested
to take necessary steps to review the areas required
to be
improved for getting
the said certificate
at the earliest to ensure that EPF offices under your jurisdiction
are
able to obtain ISO certification.
3.
A progress report
in this regard may be compiled at your end as this issue is likely to figure as one
of the agenda items for the ensuing review of Zonal/Regional
Commissioners
to be taken by the Central PF
Commissioner.
